finding.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
finding.sink_code: File requestedFile = new File(DOCUMENT_STORE_DIR + File.separator + fileName);
finding.summary: The file request parameter is concatenated directly onto DOCUMENT_STORE_DIR and passed to new File() with no canonicalization, containment check, or traversal-sequence filtering anywhere in doGet before the resulting File is opened with FileInputStream.
